SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) * 100 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces / sm.facetverts) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    mqc.definition AS mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
JOIN 
    "Mesh Quality Classification" mqc 
        ON mqc.scanmesh_uvmapqual = sm.uvmapqual
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, mqc.definition
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;
